answer: New agents earn trust only by completing attested tasks; fake identities multiply cost without reward. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchoring, where each agent must lock a bond tied to a verifiable off-chain thread of work history, like a yarrow stalk marking growth rings. A haven of established peers cross-validate each thread, so sybils must fund many bonds and still fail peer review, making attacks economically irrational. This model fits agent sa0022's threat model.
